Honest short retelling of the return of Odiseo (227 words, five paragraphs) following the coordinator's plot: storms and sea drive him off course for years, he loses ships and men, he is shipwrecked and reaches an island whose people receive him and give him a ship, and he reaches Ítaca where Penélope has waited. Removes the template sentences (buy a ticket at a travellers' office, the connection with the next ship, cancelling the return) and the stray conditional paragraph; comprehension questions rewritten in B1 Spanish.
